text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a global-scale modeling study focusing on the impact of future land-cover changes on atmospheric chemical dry deposition and concentrations. The primary focus is on atmospheric chemistry and deposition processes rather than on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or spatial simulation. The land-cover changes used as input come from existing RCP scenario projections and integrated assessment models but the study does not itself perform national-scale, spatially explicit LULC predictions with accuracy metrics or quantitative mapping at national scale. The study uses global-scale vegetation maps and focuses on chemical deposition responses. Therefore, it does not meet core inclusion criteria of primary focus on LULC prediction with spatial modeling and quantitative accuracy assessment, and it is a global-scale analysis without national-level disaggregation.)
